description: This file provides helper functions and type definitions for streaming text responses in Slack using the Slack SDK's ChatStreamer. It manages starting, appending to, and stopping a Slack text stream, facilitating real-time message updates in Slack channels or DMs.

classes.name: SlackStreamSession
classes.description: Represents an active Slack streaming session, including the ChatStreamer instance, channel, thread timestamp, and stopped state.

methods.name: startSlackStream
methods.description: Initializes a new Slack text stream, optionally sending initial markdown text, and returns a session object.

methods.name: appendSlackStream
methods.description: Appends markdown text to an active Slack stream session.

methods.name: stopSlackStream
methods.description: Stops the Slack stream, optionally appending final markdown text, and marks the session as stopped.
